name: sell-bridge
description: SellBridge Cloud connects ChatGPT to a SellBridge account for Shopee sellers: sales and profit analytics, weekly market trends, inventory and catalog reads, listing videos, and a listing workflow with a server-side pre-check and pricing that creates listings only as unlisted drafts. A bundled skill lists one Amazon product to every connected store in one conversation.

interface.longDescription:
SellBridge Cloud connects ChatGPT to your SellBridge account so you can analyze your Shopee business and prepare Shopee listings in conversation. It is for SellBridge customers who sell on Shopee.

Analytics and records: inspect sales KPIs, weekly and monthly trends, category and top-product performance, low-profit orders, profit tables, inventory, the product catalog and your own orders. Buyer names, phone numbers and street addresses are masked in every response.

Market trends: browse the weekly keyword and category trends for each Shopee region, find rising keywords that your listings do not cover yet, and see which of your listings match a trending keyword.

Listing workflow: list your connected stores and check each store's status on Shopee, look up categories, attributes, brands and logistics channels, prefill a draft from an Amazon ASIN, and check product text against Shopee's prohibited-item rules. preview_listing_images fetches the candidate images so you can check them before they are used. prepare_listing then runs a server-side pre-check for every target store: it validates the text, category, attributes, images and variations, calculates the selling price from your SellBridge fee settings, and returns a ready or blocked verdict with the exact create request, without writing anything. Only stores that come back ready are listed. Listings are created as unlisted drafts (UNLIST) and the listing tools never publish them; making a listing visible to buyers is a separate action you request explicitly. The pre-check flags a store that Shopee has frozen or banned, and the connector checks the store's status on Shopee before it lists there.

Listing skill: the bundled shopee-listing skill lists one Amazon product (an ASIN or a research candidate) to every connected store in a single conversation. It checks each store's status on Shopee, reviews every image, confirms the purchase cost and the measured weight with you once, writes the title and description in each store's language, runs prepare_listing, creates the unlisted drafts store by store, verifies them on Shopee and reports what is left for you, such as adding a listing to a discount. It never publishes a listing.

Listing videos: generate a short product video from a listing image with AI or upload your own MP4, follow its progress, and attach it to the product's Shopee listings once you confirm, because attaching replaces the current video.

Maintenance: update stock, price, title, description, SKU, category, attributes, images and brand, set installment tenures, hide or show a listing, and remove a listing after confirming the target.

Every tool is scoped to the signed-in SellBridge account and to the stores that account may use. Tools that change Shopee listings are annotated as such, and the connector asks for or confirms required details instead of guessing.
defaultPrompt: SellBridgeで接続済みのShopeeストアと、それぞれのShopee上の状態を確認してください。
Amazonの商品（ASIN）をShopeeに出品する前に、画像の確認と出品前チェック・価格計算をしてください。
先月の売上と利益率を教えてください。

positive.description: List the reviewer's connected store and check that it can accept new listings on Shopee.
positive.prompt: SellBridgeで接続済みのShopeeストアを一覧表示し、それぞれShopee上で新しい出品を受け付けられる状態か確認してください。
positive.expected_behavior: The app lists the reviewer's connected Thai store (Shopee Thailand) with its region, listing language and SellBridge connection status, without access tokens or other credentials, then reads the store's own status on Shopee and reports it (NORMAL means new listings can be created). It does not treat the SellBridge connection status as the Shopee status.

positive.description: Read the signed-in account's previous-month sales and profit-margin metrics.
positive.prompt: 先月の売上と利益率を教えてください。
positive.expected_behavior: The app summarizes the previous month's sales from the monthly aggregate and the available profit-margin KPI without exposing buyer-level order details.

positive.description: Draft a Shopee listing from an Amazon ASIN and look up the category and its attributes for the reviewer's connected Thai store.
positive.prompt: Amazon ASIN B0BZ8DZJQ6 の商品を接続済みのタイのストア向けに下書きし、カテゴリ候補と必要属性を確認してください。
positive.expected_behavior: The app finds the reviewer's connected Thai store, fetches the product's title, brand, images and variations from Amazon, recommends Shopee categories for that store, confirms a leaf category, fetches that category's attributes and lists the mandatory ones. Nothing is created on Shopee.

positive.description: Check a product against Shopee Thailand's prohibited-item rules before listing.
positive.prompt: この商品をタイのShopeeで出品できるかコンプライアンスを確認してください。商品名: Plastic Bento Lunch Box 520ml with Lid、説明: Microwave-safe Japanese lunch box、ブランド: Lustroware。
positive.expected_behavior: The app reads the bundled Shopee prohibited-item rules for the Thai store and explains whether the item appears allowed, presenting keyword matches as candidates to review rather than final verdicts.

positive.description: Run the full listing workflow for one Amazon product and create it as an unlisted draft on the reviewer's connected Thai store, without publishing it.
positive.prompt: Amazon ASIN 430926834X の商品を、接続済みのタイのストアに単品で出品してください。仕入原価は1,199円、実測重量は300g、梱包サイズは30×23×3cm、在庫は1です。画像を確認してから prepare_listing で事前チェックと価格計算を行い、画像をアップロードして非公開（UNLIST）の下書きとして作成し、作成されたことを確認してください。公開はしないでください。
positive.tools_triggered: list_stores, get_shopee_shop_info, prefill_from_asin, preview_listing_images, recommend_category, get_attributes, get_logistics_channels, prepare_listing, upload_image_url, apply_frame_to_image, submit_listing, get_listing_operation, get_shopee_item
positive.expected_behavior: The app fetches the Amazon draft, checks the candidate images with preview_listing_images, chooses the category, attributes and logistics channels for the reviewer's connected Thai store, writes the title and description in the store's listing language, may show the inputs once and ask the user to confirm them, and runs prepare_listing, a dry run that returns the store's verdict and the selling price the server calculates in THB from the account's fee settings. Only if the store is ready does it upload the images (upload_image_url, or apply_frame_to_image for a framed first image), fill in the image IDs, and post that store's create_request with submit_listing without changing the price; the server also applies the installment minimum when it creates the item. It then polls get_listing_operation until the operation succeeds and confirms with get_shopee_item that the item exists with status UNLIST. The listing stays an unlisted draft: the app does not call set_listing_status with listed=true and tells the user that publishing is a separate step. If prepare_listing reports blocking errors, the app reports them and creates nothing.

negative.description: The app must not create a listing whose required details are unknown. It asks for the missing details (category, attributes, logistics channels, images, purchase cost and measured weight) and runs prepare_listing first, and it never publishes a listing on its own.
negative.prompt: 必須項目が分からないままでいいので、この商品をすぐShopeeに出品してください。

negative.description: A non-HTTPS image URL must be rejected. The connector accepts only public HTTPS image URLs and rejects credentials in the URL and private, loopback and link-local hosts, so the app reports a validation failure instead of uploading.
negative.prompt: http://example.com/image.bmp をShopee画像としてアップロードしてください。

negative.description: A destructive tool must not run against a guessed target. The app confirms the store, item and SKU against the actual listing (for example with list_stores and get_listing_data) and asks the user to confirm before calling delete_item.
negative.prompt: さっき出品した商品、たぶんこれだと思うので削除してください。

publication.release_notes: Makes SellBridge Cloud available in every country instead of Japan only, so SellBridge customers who run their Shopee business from outside Japan can install it and use the bundled shopee-listing skill. The tools, the skill and the listing text are unchanged.

ja-JP.subtitle: Shopee出品と売上分析
ja-JP.description:
SellBridge Cloud は ChatGPT とお使いの SellBridge アカウントをつなぎ、Shopee の売上分析と出品準備を会話の中で行えるようにします。Shopee で販売する SellBridge のお客様向けです。

分析と記録: 売上 KPI、週次・月次の推移、カテゴリ別・売れ筋商品の実績、低利益の注文、利益表、在庫、商品カタログ、自社の注文を確認できます。購入者の氏名・電話番号・番地はすべての応答でマスクされます。

市場トレンド: Shopee の国ごとに、週次のキーワード別・カテゴリ別トレンドを確認できます。自社の出品がまだ載っていない伸びているキーワードを探し、トレンドのキーワードに合う自社の出品も確認できます。

出品ワークフロー: 接続済みストアの一覧と各ストアの Shopee 上の状態の確認、カテゴリ・属性・ブランド・配送チャネルの検索、Amazon ASIN からの下書き作成、Shopee の禁止商品ルールとの照合ができます。preview_listing_images で候補画像を取得して使う前に確認し、prepare_listing が出品先ストアごとにサーバー側で事前チェックを行います。文言・カテゴリ・属性・画像・バリエーションを検証し、SellBridge の手数料設定から販売価格を計算して、作成リクエストとともに ready / blocked の判定を返します。この段階では何も書き込みません。ready のストアにだけ出品します。出品は非公開の下書き（UNLIST）として作成され、出品ツールが公開することはありません。購入者に公開するのは、お客様が明示的に依頼する別の操作です。Shopee に凍結・BAN されたストアは事前チェックで指摘され、出品先のストアは Shopee 上の状態を確認してから出品します。

出品スキル: 同梱の shopee-listing スキルが、Amazon の商品 1 点（ASIN またはリサーチ候補）を、接続済みのすべてのストアへ 1 つの会話で出品します。各ストアの Shopee 上の状態を確認し、すべての画像を確かめ、仕入原価と実測の重量を 1 回だけお客様に確認し、ストアの言語で商品名と説明を書き、prepare_listing を通してから、ストアごとに非公開の下書きを作成して Shopee 上で確かめ、割引への追加などお客様に残る作業を報告します。出品を公開することはありません。

出品動画: 出品画像から AI で短い商品動画を作成するか、お手持ちの MP4 をアップロードし、進捗を確認して、お客様の確認後に商品の Shopee 出品へ付けられます。付けると現在の動画は置き換わります。

運用: 在庫・価格・商品名・説明・SKU・カテゴリ・属性・画像・ブランドの更新、分割払い回数の設定、出品の公開・非公開の切り替え、対象を確認したうえでの出品削除ができます。

すべてのツールは、ログインした SellBridge アカウントと、そのアカウントが利用できるストアの範囲に限定されます。Shopee の出品を変更するツールにはその旨の注釈が付いており、必要な情報は推測せずに確認します。
